P_0x007694:
Once of <Shadow Mirror>. Excellent pilot, cool but hides passion within.
He deemed Kyosuke Nanbu, who gained mysterious power in their home world, and his Gespenst Mk-III a threat, expecting this world's Kyosuke to gain similar power, and sought to defeat him.
Defeated in the final battle inside <White Star> in the <Inspector Incident>, gravely wounded. Later recovered with his Soulgain by <Earth Fed Army> <PT> unit Crye Wolves, he fought beside Kyosuke in the <Shura Revolt>.
P_0x007A15:
The only <Einst> with a near-human form, cloned from Excellen Browning's data, so her face and voice resemble hers.
She fought Kyosuke's group often in the <Inspector Incident>, but was drawn in by humanity's "power of feelings," joining them to fight Stern Neureisia, leader of the <Einst>.
P_0x007C37: A <Colony Integ. Army> soldier, seconded to the <DC> in the <DC War> and made an executive. An anti-federalist revering Bian and Meiya. Cautious yet bold.
P_0x007D5B: A mercenary wielding the Guarlion Custom "Mumyo" and Shishiou Blade. Superb pilot and swordsman; lives to "cut" people and mobile weapons. Age 45.
P_0x007E57: Captain of the Gaia Sabers' flagship, Air Christmas. Cold and clear-headed; sees sound theory as the true path to victory.
P_0x007F34: Captain of the Guest mercenaries. Nicknamed Loff. Bold, completes any mission given, yet privately disapproves of inhumane orders. From a prestigious military family, he left home, sick of pedigree deciding one's future.
